description: Sync candidates, applications, jobs, scheduled interviews and offers from Greenhouse. Applications link to their candidate and jobs, and interviews and offers link to their application.
opening: Sync candidates, applications, jobs, scheduled interviews and offers from one Greenhouse account. Each record is one document. Applications link to their candidate and to each job applied for. Interviews and offers link to their application.

Greenhouse permissions are not imported, so every synced record is visible to everyone who can query the collection unless you set an access rule. Private candidates and confidential jobs are not restricted. Selecting jobs limits only jobs and applications: candidates, interviews and offers sync for the whole account. Changes to an offer after it is created may not be picked up, and records deleted in Greenhouse stay in HydraDB.

notes: Greenhouse's private flag on candidates and confidential flag on jobs are stored but do not restrict who can read them.
An access rule on a job does not cover candidates, interviews or offers, which sync for the whole account.

connect.auth: Greenhouse uses a Harvest API key.

steps.title: Get a Harvest API key
steps.text: Get a Harvest API key for your Greenhouse account.

steps.title: Select jobs
steps.text: HydraDB lists your jobs. Select the jobs to sync. Jobs and applications are limited to the jobs you select. Candidates, interviews and offers sync for the whole account whatever you select.

connect.account: One connector reads one Greenhouse account.

sync.first_sync: Reaches back the window set by `lookback_days`, 30 days by default.
sync.changes: Candidates and interviews are picked up when they are updated, applications when they have new activity, and selected jobs when they are updated. Offers are picked up when they are created.
sync.edits: An edited candidate, application, job or interview replaces its document. Changes to an older offer may not be picked up, so its status can be out of date.
sync.deletes: Records deleted in Greenhouse stay searchable in HydraDB.
notes: A new version of an offer keeps the same offer id, so it replaces the earlier version's document. Earlier versions are not kept.

shared_attributes.name: Greenhouse id
shared_attributes.text: The record's Greenhouse id, written into the text as its key.

shared_attributes.name: connector_id
shared_attributes.text: Limits a query to this connector's records. Not searchable.

documents.name: Candidates
documents.title: The candidate's first and last name. Otherwise `Greenhouse candidate` and its id.
documents.text: The name, then `Company`, `Title`, `Tags` and `Emails` lines, and each past employment and education. The creation time is part of the text. The title is searchable too.
documents.date: When the candidate was last updated, or created when there is no update time.
documents.files: Resumes and other candidate attachments are not synced.

attributes.name: first_name, last_name
attributes.text: The candidate's name, in the title and the text.

attributes.name: company, job_title
attributes.text: The candidate's current employer and job title.

attributes.name: tags
attributes.text: The candidate's tags.

attributes.name: Emails
attributes.text: The candidate's email addresses, in the text only. They are not kept as a separate field.

attributes.name: employments
attributes.text: Each past employer and job title. Employment dates are stored but not searchable.

attributes.name: educations
attributes.text: Each school, degree and discipline. Education dates are stored but not searchable.

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.text: When the candidate was created. It is the result date only when there is no update time.

attributes.name: updated_at
attributes.text: When the candidate was last updated. Not searchable.

attributes.name: additional_metadata.greenhouse_candidate_id
attributes.text: The Greenhouse candidate id. Finds one candidate. Not searchable.

attributes.name: is_private
attributes.text: Greenhouse's private flag. It does not restrict who can read the candidate.

attributes.name: application_ids
attributes.text: The ids of the candidate's applications. The links to applications come from the application documents.

attributes.name: last_activity_at
attributes.text: When the candidate last had activity.

documents.name: Applications
documents.one_document: One application, for a job you selected.
documents.title: `Application:` and the names of the jobs applied for. Otherwise `Greenhouse application` and its id.
documents.text: The title, then `Status`, `Jobs` and `Rejection reason` lines, then each application question with its answer. The title is searchable too.
documents.date: When the application last had activity, or when it was submitted.

attributes.name: candidate_id
attributes.text: Links the application to its candidate. Not searchable.

attributes.name: job_ids
attributes.text: Links the application to each job applied for. Not searchable.

attributes.name: job_names
attributes.text: The names of the jobs applied for, in the title and the `Jobs` line.

attributes.name: status
attributes.text: The application status, in the `Status` line.

attributes.name: Rejection reason
attributes.text: Any rejection reason, by name. It is in the text only, not kept as a separate field.

attributes.name: Answers
attributes.text: Each application question with a non-empty answer. Answers are in the text only, not kept as separate fields.

attributes.name: last_activity_at
attributes.text: When the application last had activity. Not searchable.

attributes.name: applied_at
attributes.text: When the candidate applied. It is the result date only when there is no activity time. Not searchable.

attributes.name: additional_metadata.greenhouse_application_id
attributes.text: The Greenhouse application id. Finds one application. Not searchable.

attributes.name: rejected_at
attributes.text: When the application was rejected.

documents.name: Jobs
documents.title: The job name. Otherwise `Greenhouse job` and its id.
documents.text: The name, then `Requisition`, `Status`, `Departments` and `Offices` lines. The creation time is part of the text. The title is searchable too.
documents.date: When the job was opened, or created when there is no open time.

attributes.name: name
attributes.text: The job name, in the title and the text.

attributes.name: requisition_id
attributes.text: The requisition reference, in the `Requisition` line.

attributes.name: status
attributes.text: The job status, in the `Status` line.

attributes.name: departments, offices
attributes.text: Department and office names. Office locations are not searchable.

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.text: When the job was created. It is the result date only when there is no open time.

attributes.name: opened_at
attributes.text: When the job was opened. Not searchable.

attributes.name: additional_metadata.greenhouse_job_id
attributes.text: The Greenhouse job id. Finds one job. Not searchable.

attributes.name: confidential
attributes.text: Greenhouse's confidential flag. It does not restrict who can read the job.

attributes.name: closed_at
attributes.text: When the job was closed.

documents.name: Interviews
documents.title: `Interview with` and the interviewers' names. Otherwise `Greenhouse interview` and its id.
documents.text: The title, then `Status`, `Start`, `End`, `Location`, `Video conferencing`, `Interviewers` and `Organizer` lines. The creation time is part of the text. The title is searchable too.
documents.date: When the interview was last updated. Otherwise its start time, then its creation time.

attributes.name: application_id
attributes.text: Links the interview to its application. Not searchable.

attributes.name: interviewers
attributes.text: Each interviewer's name and email. Names are also in the title. Interviewers are not attached to the interview as people in the graph.

attributes.name: Organizer
attributes.text: The organizer's name and email, in the text only.

attributes.name: start
attributes.text: When the interview starts. It is the result date only when there is no update time.

attributes.name: end
attributes.text: When the interview ends.

attributes.name: location, video_conferencing_url
attributes.text: The interview location and video conferencing link. The link is not a link back to Greenhouse.

attributes.name: status
attributes.text: The interview status, in the `Status` line.

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.text: When the interview was created. It is the result date only when there is no update or start time.

attributes.name: updated_at
attributes.text: When the interview was last updated. Not searchable.

attributes.name: additional_metadata.greenhouse_interview_id
attributes.text: The Greenhouse interview id. Finds one interview. Not searchable.

attributes.name: Interviewer responses
attributes.text: Each interviewer's response status.

documents.name: Offers
documents.one_document: One offer. A new version with the same offer id replaces it.
documents.title: `Greenhouse offer` and its id.
documents.text: `Status`, `Version`, `Sent`, `Resolved` and `Starts` lines. The creation time is part of the text. The title is searchable too.
documents.date: When the offer was last updated, or created when there is no update time.

attributes.name: application_id
attributes.text: Links the offer to its application. Not searchable.

attributes.name: status, version
attributes.text: The offer status and version, as recorded when the offer was last read.

attributes.name: sent_at, resolved_at, starts_at
attributes.text: When the offer was sent and resolved, and the proposed start date.

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.text: When the offer was created. It decides when the offer is synced, and it is the result date only when there is no update time.

attributes.name: updated_at
attributes.text: When the offer was last updated, as of the last time it was read. A later update does not cause it to be read again. Not searchable.

attributes.name: additional_metadata.greenhouse_offer_id
attributes.text: The Greenhouse offer id. Finds one offer. Not searchable.

example_searches: Which applications for the backend engineer job are active?
Which interviewers and times were recorded for this application?
Which offers were accepted, and what start dates do they show?

connections: An application to each job applied for.
graph.people: Interviewers and organizers are not attached to an interview as people. Their names and emails are in the text only.
graph.from_text: Candidate profiles, application answers, job details, interview details with interviewer and organizer names, and offer terms.

not_synced: Jobs you did not select, and applications for them.
Scorecards, interview feedback, candidate notes and activity feed entries.
Candidate phone numbers, addresses, websites and social links.
Deletions: records deleted in Greenhouse stay in HydraDB.
